meta.name: give-me-tips
meta.description: Explains any senpi tip in depth - startup tips, working tips, and any Tip: line shown in the TUI (including the Fable-5-refusal fallback tip). Use when the user asks about a Tip: line, says give-me-tips, asks what a tip means, how a tipped feature works, or which tips they can see. Queries the live tip list (senpi --list-tips) first, checks what THIS user can actually see, then verifies the real feature code before explaining.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 深入解释任何senpi提示的含义与用法
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果使用senpi时想弄懂每条提示在说什么
copy.tagline_en: Explain any senpi tip in depth
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to understand what each senpi tip means and how to use it

howto.what: 装上后，当你问起 senpi 里的某条 Tip 提示时，Claude 会先运行命令拉取实时提示列表，再读取你的设置，判断你实际能看到哪几条，然后去查看相关源码，用你的语言给出具体机制的解释，并注明代码出处；如果提示文字和代码不一致，以代码为准。
howto.when: 当用户提到某个 Tip: 行、说“give-me-tips”，或询问提示含义、功能原理等时触发。

say.text: 这条 Tip: 行是什么意思？
say.note: 它会查实时列表并核对代码后解释。

say.text: 我刚才看到的启动提示是怎么运作的？
say.note: 会说明哪些提示对你是可见的及原因。

say.text: Fable 5 拒绝后的那条提示是什么原理？
say.note: 会讲解 fallback-architect 的完整流程。

howto.what_en: When the user asks about any senpi Tip line, Claude first queries the live tip list, reads the user's settings to see which tips they can actually see, then checks the real feature code before explaining in the user's language with cited file paths; if code and tip text disagree, code wins.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user mentions a Tip: line, says 'give-me-tips', asks what a tip means, how a tipped feature works, or which tips they can see.

say_en.text: What does this Tip: line mean?
say_en.note: Queries the live list and verifies code before explaining.

say_en.text: How does the startup tip I saw work?
say_en.note: Tells which tips are visible to you and why.

say_en.text: What's behind the tip after a Fable 5 refusal?
